scheme_name: Consolidated Stipend Scheme for Scheduled Caste Students Pursuing Higher Education
other_conditions: Applicant must be a domicile of Haryana.
Applicant must be studying in a government college in Haryana.
Applicant must have passed the previous academic year examination.
Applicant must maintain at least 60% attendance in classes.
benefits_summary: SC students studying in government colleges in Haryana receive a monthly stipend of ₹1,000, with an additional ₹500 per month hostel stipend for those availing hostel facilities.
